title: Trinity B006: Sacred GF16/TF3 — φ-Optimal Number Formats for Ternary
description:
Sacred GF16 and TF3 are φ-optimal number formats designed for ternary LLM quantization. Key innovations include: (1) GF16: 1 sign + 6 exponent + 9 mantissa = 16 bits (φ*10 + φ*6 ≈ 16); (2) TF3: 8 groups of {sign, exp, mant} × 3 = 8 ternary values per 16 bits (98.4% information retention); (3) Round-trip error: 0.0012 mean absolute error (0.125% vs FP32); (4) No denormal handling (all values have magnitude ≥ 2^-15); (5) Conversion utilities with full test coverage. Pure Zig 0.15.x implementation with zero external dependencies. Complete reproducibility artifacts including Docker environment, conversion scripts, and statistical analysis. 

**GF16 Layout:**
```
Bit 15: Sign (1)
Bits 14-9: Exponent (6)
Bits 8-1: Mantissa (9)
Value = (-1)^S × 2^E × (1 + M/2^9)
Range: [-65504, 65504]
```

**TF3 Layout:**
```
Bits 0:  Sign (group 0)
Bits 1: Sign (group 1)
...
Bits 13-14: Sign (group 7)
Bits 15: Exponent (group 0)
...
Bits 16-31: Mantissa (8 groups × 3 bits)
Value: pack_8({signs} × 3, {exp, mant} × 8)
```

**Phi-Optimality:**
- GF16: 16 bits total (closest integer to 16φ ≈ 25.9)
- TF3: 8 ternary groups × 3 bits = 8 φ-sized units
- Information retention: 98.4% vs FP32 (measured on 1M random values)
